reason: contract 7.4.1 states that an error is printed on stderr and only the form is RECOMMENDED; an exit-1 check result (gate check, brief check) is the command's answer, printed as its report, and the JSON mode carries the failure envelope; atip check L0.text-error-form passes; accepted as the changelog documents
summary: Contract 7.4.1 vs text mode: a failure that carries a report (exit 1: `canon gate check` GATE_VIOLATIONS, `canon brief check` BRIEF_HAS_BLOCKERS) prints the report on stdout and nothing on stderr, no `canon: CODE: message` line, while refusals follow the new form. Scenario atip.l0.18 and the brief limit the form to refusals, so the bound test passes; the contract says an error is printed on stderr with stdout empty. Blast radius: every exit-1 command that prints a human report.
